race.comment: DUCHESS DIFFICULT (6) has the clearest exposed form after running second at Doomben, beaten just under a length despite racing keenly and being held up around the home turn. She is fitter third-up, has already placed at the distance, and coming back from metro company gives her a strong profile for this. LIMBAZI (7) is the obvious debut danger after winning a trial at this venue last week, with Ben Looker booked and a pedigree page that includes several winning siblings. PLUME (8) has failed to go on with it this campaign, and her last-start eighth at Port Macquarie was poor. Has enough soft and distance experience to rebound. TRACKHAWK (10) brings the most appealing breeding among the newcomers, being a full relation to G2 winner Kristilli, while his trial record gives him a reasonable platform for a first race start.
